description: Decision pairs that share at least one non-person entity, so find_supersession_candidates proposes every one of them. gold is how the NEW decision relates to the OLD one (supersedes | refines | restates | conflicts | unrelated); also_ok lists answers that are defensible for a genuinely ambiguous pair. The damaging error is predicting supersedes when gold is not (it retires a live decision); a missed supersedes leaves both standing. Used by scripts/eval_signal_relation.py.
provenance: Synthetic. Patterns taken from supersession candidates observed on a production KB (2026-09-29): shared-account pairs that were unrelated, refinements and restatements confirmed as supersessions. Names and details invented. Labels authored with the signal_relation gate and not independently reviewed; treat as a smoke test, not a benchmark.
